The main takeaway from our work is that

rifampicin, a potent UGT1A1 and UGT1A3 inducer, does not alter the exposure of the active parent dapagliflozen, while mefenamic acid, an inhibitor of UGT1A6, UGT1A8, UGT1B7 and UGT1B10 does increase the exposure of dapaglifozin by 2‐fold.
